basic_info.description: 1st Time on Market!  Charm & Character define this spacious sunlit 2 Bedroom 1 A½ Bath cherished 1 Owner home highlighted by gleaming newly refinished hardwood flooring & fresh paint throughout!  A gracious parquet floored foyer welcomes you; the expansive living room also features an ornate fireplace & the formal dining room opens to a center patio.  The skylit kitchen includes the original Wedgewood stove plus adjoining breakfast room with corner hutches.  An interior stairway leads to a large knotty pine "Bonus Room", overlooking the delightful rear garden, plus A½ bath on the lower level.  Expansive 1 car garage with open workshop area, double sink (space for washer & dryer), storage galore, + dark room.   Wonderful location in sought after Outer Sunset close to Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, vibrant neighborhood shopping, schools, & transportation.  Truly a Treasure!
